body:
## Pensieve 0.5.3

### Fixed
- **Importing from Notion** no longer means one page at a time: pick Notion's whole-workspace export and everything comes in at once.
- **Imported Notion pages** no longer show up as a pile of sub-pages under an extra "Notion export" page: Notion's top-level pages stay top-level, pages keep Notion's nesting and order, and each page inside a page appears once, as a block in its text (no second set of cards above it).
- **Sub-page buttons:** long titles no longer run out of their button; they're cut with "…".
- **Notion databases** came in as a .csv attachment or a plain table; now they're databases (below).
- **Paper reader:** clicking a card in *Notes* sometimes stopped short of its passage far down a long paper; it now goes right to it.

### New
- **Pages work like Notion:** a page tree on the Pages screen and beside an open page. Drag a page to reorder it or put it inside another, **+** to add a page inside, **Move to…** any page or project, **Duplicate** copies the pages inside too, and deleting a page deletes the pages inside it (with Undo).
- **Databases:** a table of pages with property columns (Status, Authors, Year…). Edit cells, add rows and properties; a row's page shows its properties at the top.
- **One Import button** for Notion (everything at once, or linked to update later), Obsidian / Markdown folders and single files, with short step-by-step guides.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.5.3.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.5.3-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.5.3-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.5.3-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.5.3-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.5.3-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.5.3-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
